description:
Aggregate the work that makes each issue mutation derive its coupled state inside its own plan: dependent readiness, field changes, lease checks and bulk application.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One pure function derives dependent Ready and Backlog corrections, and every mutation that changes a state or a dependency carries them in its own redo record.
- [hard] REQ-02: No command publishes a follow-up mutation to correct readiness after its primary mutation commits.
- [hard] REQ-03: The dedicated assign, unassign, gate-add and gate-remove commands, single-issue update and bulk update produce the same issue state and events for the same change, through one state derivation.
- [hard] REQ-04: User-requested writes to existing issues check leases inside their publishing session through one check with one message definition.
- [hard] REQ-05: Bulk update has no separate preview, processes every matched issue in one session and publishes one redo record.
title: Mutations derive their coupled readiness, field, lease and bulk state in one session
